digest.component_or_area: Jira adapter package (adapters/jira/) and file-location loader
propositions: The eight remaining Jira modules (acli*, adf, outbound_fields, comment_limits) must be physically moved from the package root into adapters/jira/ with no re-export shim.

The file-location loader must be taught the new directory via relative subpaths for the three location-pinned modules (adf, outbound_fields, comment_limits) without breaking the ~30 other root modules it loads.
Every surviving dotted and sibling-filename reference to the moved modules must be repointed to adapters.jira.* atomically in the same change, or imports fail at runtime.

Test targets in categories 2 (spec_from_file_location path constants) and 3 (direct dotted imports) must be rewritten to the new adapters/jira/ paths, while path-agnostic _load_acli patch.object sites are left unedited.
The move is a pure relocation with no behavior change, verified complete when grep for old root paths returns zero hits in src/ and tests/ and the full suite is green.
All reconciler modules must remain within the 800-LOC module-size cap after the move.
